claims.name: UserManager
responsibilities: registers users with validation and duplicate checks

claims.name: UserRegistry
responsibilities: looks up users by email, student number and librarian code

UserFactory factory = student ? new StudentFactory() : new LibrarianFactory();

claims.condition: role invalid, name empty, or password not 8-32 characters throws IllegalArgumentException

claims.name: PersistenceManager
responsibilities: saves and queries User, Student and Librarian entities
